description: This is a C source file implementing a stand-alone HTTP server for HNAP (Home Network Administration Protocol), handling HTTP requests, parsing headers, performing authentication, and managing socket connections for a home security system component.

methods.name: HTTP_ParseHeaders
methods.description: Parses HTTP request headers from a file stream, extracting method, location, content length, SOAP action, and authorization headers.

methods.name: HTTP_AuthDecode
methods.description: Decodes Basic HTTP Authentication header into username and password.

methods.name: HTTP_HandleRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, performs request parsing, authentication, and delegates to HDK request handler.

methods.name: alarm_handler
methods.description: Handles SIGALRM signals to manage home security timeout procedures.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main server loop: initializes socket, binds to interface, listens for connections, and processes incoming HTTP requests.
